description.value: OEB Breakfast Co. is a farm-to-table breakfast and brunch chain founded by chef Mauro Martina in Calgary in 2009, now operating across Canada including this Brentwood Town Centre outpost in Burnaby. The chef-driven menu centres on eggs benedicts, breakfast poutines, and fresh-ingredient dishes sourced from local Canadian suppliers, with vegetarian and gluten-friendly options throughout. Takeout and delivery service make it a practical morning or midday stop for cyclists passing through the Brentwood corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 21m; stands (22 spaces, covered) at 44m. Total: 25 spaces.
